comment: Kodak VISION Color Print Film 2383 'Modulation-Transfer Function Curves' (F010_0292AC), p.4. Raster image (525x488 px native), read by eye from a 400 dpi render. Log-log axes, 1-600 cycles/mm by 1-200 % response; exposure 3200K tungsten, process ECP-2D, Status A, '35% Modulation Target' (the printed note; the response is read at the datasheet's stated target). Axis calibration from the drawn gridlines on the 400 dpi render (clip aligned to whole pixels, origin 36.0 / 341.64 pt): 1 c/mm at pixel x 210 and 100 c/mm at 1015.5; 100 % at pixel y 328 and 10 % at 698; converted to PDF points as (clip origin px + pixel) * 72/400. The three curves are black, near-coincident from 2.5 to about 10 c/mm (all start near 100-105 %), so the order there is a judgement: G on top, R middle, B bottom, consistent with the letters at the line ends. G is flat near 80 % from about 20 to 60 c/mm and then falls off a shoulder to about 67 % at 80 c/mm; R declines steadily to about 54 %; B declines to about 31 %. Curves end at about 80 c/mm.
